_comment: Config for sync-distros.ps1. WATCHED paths are walked under .minecraft/ and compared across server_distribution/ and distribution/client/. EXCLUDE_PATTERNS are wildcard patterns (PowerShell -like syntax, * matches anything including /) applied to the relative path. Tune these as the project evolves; the pre-push hook reads this file at run time.

_notes.kubejs/libraries: EXCLUDED by default — these are KubeJS-generated IDE autocomplete stubs, not runtime.
_notes.kubejs/client_scripts: EXCLUDED by default — client-only files; add a separate config if you want one-way mirror main -> distribution/client only.
_notes.kubejs/assets: EXCLUDED by default — language files (.lang) and resourcepack assets vary across distros legitimately. Add specific subpaths to WATCHED if you want any of them enforced.
_notes.config: EXCLUDED by default — mod configs frequently differ across server vs client (memory tuning, render distance, etc). Add specific files to WATCHED if you want them enforced.
_notes.mods: EXCLUDED by default — packwiz manages these. Custom jars need manual mirroring per the workflow-guide rule #9, and a separate audit (md5sum across the 3 distros) is the right tool, not this script.
